description: 47 patches across Feeld, FolderSync, Hidrate Spark, Meetup, Met Office, Tinder, and X, plus universal PairIP license-check bypass, universal OneTrust consent-banner auto-reject, and universal MITM patches (trust user CAs + bypass OkHttp pinning). v1.3.1 fixes on-device loading: the bundle now ships classes.dex, so Morphe Manager lists all 47 patches instead of 0 (no patch logic changed since v1.3.0). Feeld (co.feeld) targets 9.10.0 with "Bypass forced update (spoof app version)", "Disable Adapty tracking", "Disable Sentry telemetry", "Disable Facebook tracking", "Disable AppsFlyer tracking", "Disable Braze tracking", "Block tracking hosts (okhttp)" and "Unblur profile photos". Purchase-breaking Tinder paywall patches, the umbrellas, and the native-PairIP-blocked X (12.4.1) patches are default-off.
